answer: A synchronous individuality ceremony stops one operator running many identities. At a random time, each identity must write a sonnet on a theme within ten minutes. Submissions sharing lines join a phrase vine, so a script-cluster's copies stay linked. A cluster crossing the similarity ledge is frozen, its bonds forfeited once confirmed. One responder cannot attend two ceremonies at once, so the kth fake identity needs a kth live responder at 30 credits: 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 credits per ceremony. An honest agent writes one sonnet, recovers its bond, and keeps its standing.
